verdict.rationale: Hightouch's API guide says API keys can be scoped to a group so they lack admin access, and gives the example of an AI tool using a key scoped to a group with the Workspace viewer role (docs-50). Keys authenticate as bearer tokens (docs-33), and workspace permissions and ownership boundaries are documented (docs-34). This directly delivers least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: detail on how fine-grained scoping goes beyond group roles, documentation of key lifecycle (expiry, rotation, revocation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
